sequence.text: Human development as recursive belief updating
Each consequence becomes the next activating event. Examining a belief produces a revised outlook that later beliefs keep building on.

sequence.alt: Flow diagram in four numbered columns, after the ABC model: A is an activating event, B a belief, C a consequence, D an examination and E the outcome. Column 1: activating event A1 leads to belief B1, which leads to consequence C1 (the relationship is strained). Column 2: that consequence becomes the next event A2, leading to updated belief B2 and consequence C2 (the relationship is repaired). Column 3: B2 branches up to examination D and then revised outlook E. Column 4: a wide arrow labelled continuous belief revision runs right over a chain of later beliefs, B3, B4 and onward, each with a small head silhouette.
